assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for the provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All boundaries in this package come from brief/site-package/boundaries/provisional_boundaries.geojson and carry official_boundary=false. They are NOT the official red line and must be recalculated when the organizer publishes the official polygon.
assumptions.impact: Areas, ratios, lengths, building volumes and phasing are reproducible only against the provisional boundary. Once the official polygon is released, the whole metrics set must be regenerated, not patched.

assumptions.statement: Approved floor-area ratio (FAR) values for the overall design scope and the three key districts are not yet public.
assumptions.impact: proposed_key_area_floor_area_ratio is provided as a concept comparison only and must be re-derived when the planning controls are released. floor_area_ratio is tagged unknown.

assumptions.statement: Approved maximum building height, airport clearance and heritage-sightline controls are not yet public.
assumptions.impact: proposed_max_building_height_m (60 m) and proposed_average_building_height_m (34.08 m) are design suggestions, not statutory controls. official_max_building_height_m is tagged unknown.

assumptions.statement: Existing-building census vector (footprints, age, structural soundness) for the overall design scope is not provided in the site package.
assumptions.impact: Existing_building_area_sqm and demolition_area_sqm are tagged unknown. The demolition/retention section gives the decision rule and the evaluation criteria only, not a specific demolition list.

assumptions.statement: Sub-district resident population, employment series and job-population ratio for the overall design scope are not provided in the site package.
assumptions.impact: resident_population and job_population_ratio are tagged unknown. Talent-portrait segmentation uses publicly available district-level indicators only; no fabricated sub-district numbers.

assumptions.statement: Rail-station coordinate vector (alignment of existing and planned lines within the overall design scope) is not provided in the site package.
assumptions.impact: rail_station_count is tagged unknown. The proposal's transit-hub placement in the Beijing AI Origin Community is a design recommendation, not a station inventory.

assumptions.statement: Land-use codes are strictly drawn from the site-package enums/layers.json subset; no new codes were invented.
assumptions.impact: All 258 land parcels use codes 0701/0702/05/08/0802/0803/0804/0805/0806/1207/1401/1402/1403/16. Compatibility with MNR-LAND-USE-CLASSIFICATION-GUIDE is preserved.

assumptions.statement: Concept-building floor count is estimated as max(1, round(height_m_proposed / 4.0)) with 4.0 m typical floor height.
assumptions.impact: proposed_key_area_gross_floor_area_sqm and proposed_key_area_floor_area_ratio are concept comparisons. They will be replaced when official FAR and plot ratios are released.

assumptions.statement: The 300 m walkshed is computed as a straight-line buffer of the spine greenway intersected with the site, not a network-impedance walkshed.
assumptions.impact: spine_walkshed_300m_sqm and spine_walkshed_300m_coverage_ratio use a straight-line buffer, which slightly overestimates coverage compared to a network walkshed. Both numbers are reproducible from EPSG:4548 geometry.

assumptions.statement: This package is contributed under the COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY licence declared in proposal.md front matter. It contains no third-party copyrighted material, no personal data, no fabricated official approvals, and no GPL/MIT/Apache-inherited code.
assumptions.impact: The package is safe for community display and discussion. Commercial use requires separate authorisation from the contributor.
